newsitem.title: USA: Saks made $330 mln Barneys offer in Feb - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Saks made $330 mln Barneys offer in Feb - NYT.

text.p: Troubled upscale clothing retailer Barney's received a $330 million offer from Saks Holdings Inc in February but the bid was rejected, the New York Times said on Friday.
Barney's Chief Operating Officer John Brincko disclosed the offer during a Federal bankruptcy court hearing on Barney's plans to offer breakup fees to attract higher bids, the newpaper said.
On Tuesday, Saks and Japan's Isetan Co said they agreed to a joint plan of reorganization for Barney's under which Saks would aquire Barney's stock and assets for about $290 million.

Brincko was quoted as saying Saks' initial offer was rejected because it was too low. He said the $330 million bid contained adjustments that would have reduced the final amount, according to the Times.
